item.title: v0.1.1
item.description:
# Simple Mac Keyboard Control 0.1.1
- Correct Homebrew cask version interpolation while retaining exact archive checksums. - Validate real Sparkle installation and relaunch from the 0.1.0 baseline on both architectures and channels.
App controls and hardware behavior are unchanged from 0.1.0. Requires macOS 14.4 or later.
